Creates a new debug overlay.Returns the debug color used for a given node kind.Draws node bounds when bounds visualization is enabled.Draws anchor marker when anchor visualization is enabled.Draws clip region overlay for clipping nodes.Draws all enabled debug visuals for a node and its descendants.Enables or disables debug overlay rendering.Toggles bounds visualization.Toggles anchor visualization.Toggles layout metadata visualization.Toggles clip region visualization.Toggles hierarchy visualization.Restricts overlay rendering to a specific subtree root.Flips the overlay enabled state.
